svg.title: Five live-relationship states and their legal transitions
svg.desc: Cards for current, refreshing, stale, broken and denied, followed by the legal transition table with owners.
svg.text: Five visible states, one vocabulary. A spinner is not a state description.

g.text: A refresh is in flight. The

svg.text: The grant is revoked or expires
The provider or transport is lost
The source reports a newer revision
The source reports a newer revision
The provider returns; an accepted value exists
A grant is issued; an accepted value exists
A grant is issued; no value has been accepted
A refresh request is dispatched while authorised and a provider is present
A grant is issued, then a refresh is dispatched with a provider present
A validated result satisfies the freshness condition
The transport fails or the request times out
The read is refused or authority is withdrawn
Authority and provider loss move the state directly. Every refresh passes through Refreshing.
A cancelled request recomputes the chip from the facts; it never restores an old label.
